name: Naval Battle
description: Classic 2-player naval combat. Each admiral commands a hidden fleet on the configured square grid. Players alternate sequential strikes, calling coordinates to hunt and sink the enemy fleet. First to sink the entire enemy fleet wins. Fleets are deployed automatically and concealed — the duel is pure target acquisition: bracket your hits, finish wounded ships, and read the misses.

phases.name: salvo
phases.description: Players alternate strikes. One coordinate per turn.

entity_types.name: Admiral
entity_types.description: A naval commander. Reads the target grid and fires one coordinate per turn to locate and sink the enemy fleet.

properties.name: ships_remaining
properties.description: Number of this admiral's ships still afloat.

properties.name: hits_landed
properties.description: Total successful hits this admiral has scored on the enemy fleet.

properties.name: aggression
properties.description: 0 = methodical parity-search hunter, 1 = aggressive clustered bombardment.

properties.name: finishing_instinct
properties.description: How reliably the admiral chases and finishes a wounded ship before hunting elsewhere.

actions.name: fire
actions.description: Fire a salvo at one enemy grid coordinate. REQUIRED: `coord` — a square like 'F7' (row letter and column number within the configured grid). The coordinate MUST be one of `legal_targets` in your perception (a square you have not already fired on). Do NOT set a target_id — Battleship has no target entity. If you fire an invalid or repeated square the salvo is auto-redirected to a valid square.

parameters.name: coord
parameters.description: Grid coordinate to strike, e.g. 'F7'. Use a square from legal_targets for the current grid size.

agent_archetypes.name: Methodical Hunter
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: A disciplined tactician. Sweeps the grid in an efficient parity (checkerboard) pattern to guarantee contact with every ship, then switches to a tight bracket search the instant a hit lands.

agent_archetypes.name: Aggressive Bombardier
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays on instinct and pressure. Clusters fire in promising sectors, hammers wounded ships relentlessly, and gambles on where the big ships are hiding.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Tactician
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Adapts to the board. Balances broad coverage with opportunistic follow-up. Solid in every phase of the duel with no glaring weakness.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Admirals
runtime_parameters.description: Battleship is strictly 2 players, one fleet each.

runtime_parameters.name: grid_size
runtime_parameters.label: Board Size
runtime_parameters.description: Width and height of the square ocean grid (e.g. 10 = a 10x10 board).

runtime_parameters.name: ships_len_5
runtime_parameters.label: Carriers (5 cells)
runtime_parameters.description: Number of 5-cell ships in each fleet.

runtime_parameters.name: ships_len_4
runtime_parameters.label: Battleships (4 cells)
runtime_parameters.description: Number of 4-cell ships in each fleet.

runtime_parameters.name: ships_len_3
runtime_parameters.label: Cruisers (3 cells)
runtime_parameters.description: Number of 3-cell ships in each fleet.

runtime_parameters.name: ships_len_2
runtime_parameters.label: Destroyers (2 cells)
runtime_parameters.description: Number of 2-cell ships in each fleet.

runtime_parameters.name: ships_len_1
runtime_parameters.label: Patrol Boats (1 cell)
runtime_parameters.description: Number of single-cell ships in each fleet.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'Pacific theatre, dawn engagement' or 'naval academy final exam'.

termination_conditions.name: fleet_sunk
termination_conditions.description: End the game when one admiral's entire fleet is sunk.
